description: Accept/reject vectors for the parameters of the software_install and software_detect jobs (RMM Phase 5). install: the params object of a software_install job; detect: the params object of a software_detect job (rules is a JSON text). valid=true means a server builds it and an agent must accept it; valid=false means the server never sends it and an agent must refuse it (invalid_params) before it runs or downloads anything. The Go agent replays this file against internal/deploy; the PHP validators are checked against it by the generator.
